caption:
MY version of Mizeria- Polish Cucumber Salad made with simple ingredients you have in your pantry! 
This is gonna be on repeat this summer and works as the perfect side for any dish especially barbeque and grills! 

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 35 | F: 2 | P: 10
Calories: 182 per serve
Serves 1

Ingredients:
1 large cucumber OR 2 medium sized cucumber
1/4 cup greek yogurt
1/2 tsp sugar OR monkfruit 
1/2 tsp  garlic, minced
2 tbsp chopped coriander or if you fancy, use dill
1 tsp vinegar ( normal is fine, red wine vinegar tastes even better)
Squeeze lemon juice
Pinch salt - to taste
pickled red onions (recipe is on my paneer roll reel)

Method:
peel the cucumber and then use the peeler to peel strips stopping when you reach the middle as we don’t need that!
add the rest of the ingredients in the bowl and mix together - check the dish for seasoning! 
toss together in a bowl with the cucumber and stir together
top with pickled onions and a little more coriander and enjoy :) 

pro tip: 
to make this recipe completely plant based, use vegan yogurt
